faqs.question: What types of pipes do you install?
faqs.answer: We install a variety of pipes including PVC, copper, PEX, and galvanized steel depending on your specific requirements and local HVAC & AC codes.

faqs.question: How long does the installation process take?
faqs.answer: The duration depends on the scope of the project. A single fixture pipe installation might take a few hours, while whole-house repiping could take several days.

faqs.question: Do you provide a warranty on installation?
faqs.answer: Yes, we provide a comprehensive warranty on both our workmanship and the materials we supply.

faqs.question: Can you handle both residential and commercial projects?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! Our team is experienced in handling small residential pipe repairs as well as large-scale commercial pipe installations.

detail.author: Abhishek
detail.title1: Took a whole lotta: How Regular AC Maintenance
detail.intro: Keeping your air conditioner in good condition is not just about comfort, it's also a smart way to save money in the long run. Regular AC maintenance helps improve performance, reduce energy bills and prevent costly breakdowns.

features.title: 1. Improves Energy Efficiency
features.description: A well-maintained AC unit works more efficiently and consumes less electricity. Cleaning filters, checking refrigerant levels and ensuring proper airflow can significantly reduce your energy bills.

features.title: 2. Prevents Costly Repairs
features.description: Regular maintenance helps identify small issues before they turn into major problems. This can save you from expensive repairs or even a complete AC replacement.

features.title: 3. Extends the Lifespan of Your AC
features.description: With proper care and servicing, your AC can last for many more years. Regular check-ups keep all components in good condition and ensure smooth operation.

detail.quote: Regular AC maintenance is a small investment that brings big savings. It keeps your home cooler, your energy bills lower and your AC running for years to come.
detail.conclusion: Whether you use your AC at home or in the office, scheduling regular maintenance is the best way to ensure reliable performance and long-term savings. Don't wait for a breakdown - keep your AC in top shape with professional servicing.

faqs.question: How often should I service my AC?
faqs.answer: It is recommended to service your AC at least twice a year, preferably before the summer season and after heavy usage, to ensure optimal performance and longer life.

faqs.question: What types of AC units do you repair?
faqs.answer: We repair all types of AC units including split, window, and central air conditioning systems from major brands.

faqs.question: Do you provide AC installation services?
faqs.answer: Yes, we provide professional installation services for all kinds of AC units.

faqs.question: How long does an AC repair usually take?
faqs.answer: Most repairs are completed within a few hours depending on the complexity of the issue.

faqs.question: Is there a warranty on your repair services?
faqs.answer: Yes, we provide a 30-day warranty on all our repair services and parts.
